answer: Proof of Stake serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence is tied to capital allocation, transforming the network into a lotus of distributed trust. An attacker must possess significant assets to generate a whisper of authority across validators; failing this, their influence remains a cold ember, unable to initiate consensus. The cost to the adversary scales linearly with the network value, rendering the creation of multiple fake identities economically prohibitive compared to honest participation.
